name: Bloom Tender
oracle_text: Vivid — {T}: For each color among permanents you control, add one mana of that color.
blocked_sentences: Vivid — {T}: For each color among permanents you control, add one mana of that color.

needs.what: a fifth dynamic mana-ability family: a mana ability that produces one mana of EACH color present among a selector's matches -- e.g. `{"op": "add_mana", "each_color_among": {"zone": "battlefield", "controller": "you"}}` -- so the ability makes a variable-size bundle of up to {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} whose symbols are read off the board at activation, not a single mana chosen from a set. It needs the loader's mana fold to record the selector (advertising the any-color superset the way `reflecting` does, so the ability is still seen as a mana source) and `costs.mana_options_of` to build one multi-symbol production from the distinct colors of the matching permanents rather than offering a choice among them.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: All four existing board-dependent families produce exactly ONE mana that the payer chooses from a set: `reflecting` (colors an opponent's lands could produce), `in_commander_identity`, `mana_chosen_color` (`mana` as a mapping), and `split` (X mana in any combination of two named colors, a free combination and not the board's colors). Bloom Tender is neither one mana nor a choice -- it is one mana of every color the board already shows, so any of these would be a strictly different card. `add_mana` with `amount` scales one literal production tuple, which cannot vary its symbols; `add_mana_per` scales one literal unit by a selector count, so `{"mana": "{W}", "per": {"colors": ["W"], "controller": "you"}}` would add one {W} per white permanent instead of one {W} total -- and `_split_mana_rider` ends the mana half at the first effect that is not `add_mana` or `choose_mode`, so `add_mana_per` inside a mana ability is not a legal mana effect at all and `MANA_RIDER_OPS` rejects it as a rider. Five separate conditional `add_mana`s is impossible for the same reason (`if` is not a legal mana effect, and `add_mana` takes no `condition`), and the Conqueror's Flail trick of one static per color does not transfer, because a single `{T}` cost cannot be paid five times. A `choose_mode` over the 31 color combinations would hand the payer a free choice the card never offers.
